run_mcts_stats_pipeline: run the MCTS stats pipeline to aggregate episode statistics from TFRecord files
aggregate_episode_metrics: aggregate episode completion and success metrics from MCTS-generated episodes
read_tfrecord_episodes: read TFRecord episode files using Apache Beam with ProtoCoder for Episode protobuf
combine_metrics_per_key: combine and sum metrics per key across all episodes in the pipeline
write_results_to_text: write aggregated episode statistics to a text output file
